course_description: This capstone course provides a culminating experience for Organisational Sustainability students, drawing on prior knowledge and skills for authentic, experiential application. The course challenges students to evaluate real-world organisational challenges, develop adaptive responses, and reflect on their own leadership practice. Through research, stakeholder consultation, benchmarking, and implementation planning, students will bridge theory and practice to deliver feasible and forward-thinking sustainability initiatives.

prerequisites: You'll need to complete the following courses before enrolling in this one:
4-units from MBus Sustainability: Strategy and Leadership Field of Study.

course_aims:
This capstone aims to bring together students’ accumulated knowledge and apply it in a real-world, team-based project, focused on organisational sustainability.

Students will develop critical and adaptive responses to pressing sustainability challenges identified by relevant stakeholders, while building practical skills in research, consultation, benchmarking, and stakeholder engagement.

The course also supports the development of personal sustainability leadership. Students will be encouraged to reflect on their roles, values, and responsibilities as change agents, considering the ethical, relational, and strategic dimensions of influence in sustainability practice.

Ultimately, the capstone prepares students for careers where they must communicate persuasively, collaborate effectively, and lead strategically to advance sustainability within complex organisational environments.

learning_outcomes.description: Collaboratively evaluate business strategies using sustainability science frameworks and engaging with relevant stakeholders.
Propose innovative solutions to sustainability issues.
Develop a sustainability strategy that is adaptive and resilient in overcoming challenges.
Reflect on personal sustainability leadership, considering impact, relationships, ethics, and critical thinking.
Discuss sustainability initiatives to enlist support of relevant stakeholders.

learning_activities.topic: Course Introduction + Peer Recap Introduction to the capstone structure, assessment expectations, and project scope. Peer networking and review of foundational sustainability knowledge. Learning outcomes: L01, L04
Leadership + Working with Community Exploration of sustainability leadership models and strategies for building trust and influence across diverse stakeholder groups. Learning outcomes: L01, L05

Industry Partner – Top 5 Sustainability Challenges Guest session with industry partner presenting their current sustainability context and challenges. Student teams select or refine project themes. Learning outcomes: L01, L02, L03, L04, L05

Practical – Consultation + Engagement (Interviewing, Designing Questions) Workshop on effective consultation techniques and stakeholder engagement. Teams design interview guides and outreach strategies. Learning outcomes: L01, L03, L05
Practical – Data Collection + Management Practical strategies for data sourcing, analysis, and visualisation. Teams begin collecting and organising research materials. Learning outcomes: L03, L05

Progress Update Presentations Each team presents a brief progress update, receives feedback from peers and teaching staff. Focus on refining scope and direction. Learning outcomes: L01, L02, L03, L04, L05
Leadership Struggles Reflective session exploring tensions in sustainability leadership—power, resistance, and value conflicts. Learning outcomes: L03, L04
Industry Check-in (Feedback Session) Midpoint feedback from industry partner. Teams present insights and preliminary directions, and refine based on input. Learning outcomes: L01, L02, L03, L04, L05
Practical – Facing Resistance / Systemic Barriers Identify and analyse political, institutional, and cultural barriers to sustainability implementation. Learning outcomes: L01, L02, L03

Assessment Development and Team Planning Structured support for finalising assessment deliverables. Teams outline report structure, assign roles, and prepare for presentations. Learning outcomes: L01, L02, L03, L04, L05

Industry Presentations Final team presentations to industry partner and peers followed by Q&A. Emphasis on clarity, feasibility, and impact of proposed strategies. Learning outcomes: L01, L02, L03, L05

Course Recap Recap of the course and collective reflection on leadership, learning growth, and sustainability career pathways. Preparations for Leadership Reflection Interview. Learning outcomes: L02, L03, L04
Leadership reflection Interviews Scheduled individual Leadership reflection interviews (Assessment 3). Learning outcomes: L02, L03, L04
